2608.04777.title: IMFACT: Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Intrinsic Mode Function Substitution
2608.04777.paper_summary: Oscillatory signals, such as vibration, carry class-discriminative information in specific frequency bands; perturbing them in raw feature space for counterfactual analysis easily destroys their temporal structure and produces physically implausible results. In this work, we introduce IMFACT (IMF-based counterfACTuals), a model-agnostic framework for generating plausible counterfactual explanations for time series classifiers that operates in the decomposition space of Empirical Mode Decomposition. An input signal is split into Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs), and selected IMFs are progressively substituted with those of a Nearest Unlike Neighbour (NUN) until the classifier flips to the target class. We evaluate six IMF-selection strategies and a multi-NUN cycling extension on two UCR benchmarks (FaultDetectionA, FruitFlies). The variance-based strategy with three NUNs outperforms two prominent baseline techniques on reliability and plausibility metrics, while cycling across three NUNs yields the best proximity across both datasets.
2608.04777.paper_summary_zh: 振盪信號，例如振動，在特定頻率範圍內攜帶類別區分信息；在原始特徵空間中擾動它們以進行反事實分析，容易破壞它們的時間結構並產生物理上不合理的結果。在本研究中，我們引入了IMFACT（基於IMF的反事實），這是一個模型無關的框架，用於生成時間序列分類器的合理反事實解釋，它在經驗模態分解的分解空間中運作。輸入信號被分割成內在模態函數（IMFs），並且選定的IMFs逐步被最近不同鄰居（NUN）的IMFs替換，直到分類器轉換到目標類別。我們在兩個UCR基準（FaultDetectionA，FruitFlies）上評估了六種IMF選擇策略和一個多NUN循環擴展。基於方差的策略與三個NUN相比，在可靠性和合理性指標上超越了兩種顯著的基線技術，而在三個NUN之間循環則在兩個數據集上產生了最佳的接近度。
